scripts.deploy:gh: vite build --base=/personal/ && git add dist -f && git commit --allow-empty -m "deploy gh-pages" && git subtree push --prefix dist origin gh-pages
scripts.deploy:netlify: vite build && git add dist -f && git commit --allow-empty -m "deploy netlify" && git subtree push --prefix dist origin netlify-deploy
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:gh && npm run deploy:netlify
